title: Agent stuck, looping or overdelegating
symptom: The agent repeats work or keeps delegating without useful progress.
questions: Are verified milestones advancing?
Are task IDs or tool arguments repeating?
Do children share a finite root budget?

causes.title: No measurable progress
causes.evidence: Repeated action signatures and unchanged output artifacts
causes.mitigation: Stop additional actions and capture current state
causes.durableFix: Define evidence-based milestones, repetition detection and a bounded escalation path

causes.title: Unclear delegated ownership
causes.evidence: Children inspect the same scope or return incompatible outputs
causes.mitigation: Cancel redundant work and assign one owner per artifact
causes.durableFix: Require task contracts, scope exclusions, shared budgets and stale-result handling

title: Worker crash or duplicate action
symptom: A restart appears to repeat an external business effect.
questions: Did the first operation succeed remotely?
Was the same idempotency key reused?
Could a stale worker still write?

causes.title: Unknown outcome was treated as failure
causes.evidence: Provider shows success but local checkpoint lacks confirmation
causes.mitigation: Suspend retries and reconcile by operation ID
causes.durableFix: Persist intent before dispatch and retain stable deduplication keys through recovery

causes.title: Two workers retained authority
causes.evidence: Overlapping lease history or late writes from the original worker
causes.mitigation: Fence the stale owner and inspect all effects
causes.durableFix: Enforce fencing/version checks at the side-effect boundary and test reassignment

title: Context missing or ignored
symptom: The agent misses earlier constraints or contradicts available evidence.
questions: Was the information stored?
Was it selected and included in the actual prompt?
Did compaction change exact IDs or pending actions?

causes.title: Information omitted during assembly
causes.evidence: Required evidence exists but is absent from the model input
causes.mitigation: Reload the needed evidence and active constraints
causes.durableFix: Add context-assembly tracing and preservation tests

causes.title: Information included but misused
causes.evidence: Prompt contains the evidence but answer contradicts it
causes.mitigation: Stop dependent actions and request a checked answer
causes.durableFix: Reduce distracting context and test claim-level support with representative long traces

causes.title: Storage loss
causes.evidence: The authoritative record is missing before retrieval begins
causes.mitigation: Recover from a retained artifact or ask for the missing information
causes.durableFix: Separate durable task state from transient chat and test restoration

causes.title: Stale source
causes.evidence: Retrieved content is an older source version despite correct selection
causes.mitigation: Consult the authoritative current version before acting
causes.durableFix: Propagate document updates and record lineage/version in context

title: Stale, wrong or cross-user memory
symptom: Recalled information is outdated, poisoned or belongs to another scope.
questions: What is the provenance and timestamp?
Was a correction propagated?
Which namespace and authorization scope was queried?

causes.title: Correction missed derived stores
causes.evidence: Old value remains in a summary, vector index or cache
causes.mitigation: Stop using the record and correct all derived copies
causes.durableFix: Implement supersession, invalidation and deletion propagation tests

causes.title: Isolation failed
causes.evidence: Recall includes another user's or project's records
causes.mitigation: Disable the affected retrieval path and investigate exposure
causes.durableFix: Enforce namespaces and authorization before retrieval; add cross-tenant tests

title: Retrieval irrelevant, incomplete or unauthorized
symptom: The answer lacks required evidence or sees documents outside scope.
questions: Was source extraction faithful?
Did retrieval return the necessary passage?
Was authorization filtering applied before context assembly?

causes.title: Ingestion lost structure
causes.evidence: Parsed text drops headers, units, pages or table associations
causes.mitigation: Use the original source and repair extraction
causes.durableFix: Maintain source lineage and regression cases for messy documents

causes.title: Recall or permissions failure
causes.evidence: Known relevant documents are absent or forbidden ones are present
causes.mitigation: Stop relying on the result; restrict the failing path
causes.durableFix: Evaluate recall and access exclusion independently, then tune hybrid retrieval or reranking

title: Wrong tool, timeout or false success
symptom: A tool call is malformed, stalled, misdirected or reported complete without evidence.
questions: Did validation reject before dispatch or did the request leave?
Does the operation have a queryable status?
Was accepted confused with completed?

causes.title: Ambiguous tool interface
causes.evidence: Similar descriptions produce repeated wrong selections
causes.mitigation: Restrict available tools and show explicit usage examples
causes.durableFix: Evaluate selection with competing tools and redesign names/contracts

causes.title: Outcome unknown after timeout
causes.evidence: No response but remote state may have changed
causes.mitigation: Reconcile rather than unconditionally retrying
causes.durableFix: Add operation IDs, status lookup and distinct pending/unknown/completed states

causes.title: Argument rejected before dispatch
causes.evidence: Validation log shows the request never left the application
causes.mitigation: Correct the invalid field; do not retry unchanged input
causes.durableFix: Make schema and semantic errors actionable and test malformed arguments

causes.title: Authorization denied
causes.evidence: Policy check denies the caller, target or current action
causes.mitigation: Stop and request a properly scoped decision; never bypass the check
causes.durableFix: Enforce per-object authorization and clarify permitted actions

causes.title: Accepted but not completed
causes.evidence: Provider returns an operation ID or pending status without the postcondition
causes.mitigation: Poll within a deadline or expose pending status
causes.durableFix: Distinguish accepted, pending, verified and failed outcomes in the tool contract

causes.title: Postcondition mismatch
causes.evidence: Provider reports success but the wrong target/version changed
causes.mitigation: Stop further writes and reconcile affected records
causes.durableFix: Verify business invariants and actual external state before completion

causes.title: Missing observability
causes.evidence: There is no trustworthy operation ID or dispatch record
causes.mitigation: Preserve uncertainty and assign manual investigation
causes.durableFix: Add correlated intent, dispatch, provider and verification records

title: Rising cost, queues or provider limits
symptom: Spend or completion latency increases and capacity becomes constrained.
questions: Are attempts per verified success rising?
Is queue age or in-flight work growing?
Did the task mix, provider quota or human review demand change?

causes.title: Retry amplification
causes.evidence: SDK, worker and orchestrator each retry the same failure
causes.mitigation: Limit admission and establish one retry owner
causes.durableFix: Use shared budgets, backoff and failure classification

causes.title: Overload or insufficient review capacity
causes.evidence: Queue age and escalations grow despite healthy HTTP responses
causes.mitigation: Shed or defer work within the operating contract
causes.durableFix: Load-test realistic bursts and size end-to-end capacity including review

causes.title: Demand or task mix changed
causes.evidence: More tasks or longer inputs arrived without a comparable traffic baseline
causes.mitigation: Apply the defined admission limits and review the workload
causes.durableFix: Forecast by task class and distinguish volume from per-task cost

causes.title: Provider throttling
causes.evidence: Rate-limit responses or quota usage correlate with delays
causes.mitigation: Reduce concurrency and honor bounded backoff
causes.durableFix: Align admission control and validated fallback with provider quotas

causes.title: Human-review bottleneck
causes.evidence: Automated stages complete while approval queue age increases
causes.mitigation: Reduce action scope and prioritize critical reviews
causes.durableFix: Include staffed review capacity in throughput planning

title: Offline evaluations pass, users disagree
symptom: Production quality falls outside what the current evaluation detects.
questions: Can a reported failure be reproduced with the same versions?
Does the grader fail a known-bad output?
Is the affected segment represented?

causes.title: Unrepresentative cases
causes.evidence: Production task types differ from the benchmark
causes.mitigation: Pause expansion and gather reviewed representative cases
causes.durableFix: Version datasets, holdouts and per-segment gates

causes.title: Grader misses the business outcome
causes.evidence: Fluent completion text passes while external state is wrong
causes.mitigation: Manually inspect outcome and revise the acceptance check
causes.durableFix: Combine output assessment with deterministic postconditions and calibrated review

title: Regression after a deployment
symptom: A new prompt, model, tool or framework version changes outcomes.
questions: Which configuration changed?
Are in-flight jobs compatible?
Has a documented rollback condition been met?

causes.title: Behavior change escaped release checks
causes.evidence: Failures cluster by new version or segment
causes.mitigation: Stop expansion and roll back using the operating plan
causes.durableFix: Add the confirmed case to regression gates and test old-state compatibility

causes.title: External dependency changed independently
causes.evidence: Provider alias or integration behavior differs with unchanged app code
causes.mitigation: Use a validated fallback or manual route
causes.durableFix: Track actual versions, retirement notices and production quality signals
